en: Garm broke free! It's faster now, but more fragile

en: Hati · Moon Chaser — the darker the moonlight, the stronger it grows

keys: 哈提 · 逐月之狼 —— 兄弟之死让它陷入狂暴！
en: Hati · Moon Chaser — its brother's death drives it into a frenzy!

en: Hel · Queen of the Dead — Naglfar is about to set sail

keys: 海拉登上了纳吉尔法尔！船帆展开，指甲如雨落下
en: Hel boards Naglfar! The sails unfurl and nails rain down

keys: 赫列姆 · 霜巨人之王 —— 他从冰封的海上走来
en: Hrym · King of the Frost Giants — he walks across the frozen sea

keys: 「无所谓……纳吉尔法尔……已经起航了……」
en: "It doesn't matter... Naglfar... has already set sail..."

keys: 尼德霍格 · 噬根之龙 —— 世界树在颤抖

en: "The World Tree... will wither... in the end..."

keys: 斯库尔 · 追日之狼 —— 它追上了太阳
en: Sköll · Sun Chaser — it has caught the sun

keys: 扇形斩击，自动砍向攻击范围内最近的敌人
en: Fan-shaped slashes that automatically strike the nearest enemy in range

keys: 每第 4 刀变为前后双刀斩，伤害翻倍
en: Every 4th slash cuts both front and back for double damage

keys: 定住屏幕内所有敌人，空间裂痕同时爆开，重创全屏
en: Freezes every enemy on screen, then rifts in space burst open and devastate them all
The Island · A Duel at Dawn

keys:
千日为锻，万日为炼。
这一刀，连天地也斩得开。
en:
A thousand days to forge, ten thousand to temper.
This blade can cleave heaven and earth.

keys: 快速射击射程内最近的敌人，每打 6 发换一次弹
en: Rapid-fires at the nearest enemy in range, reloading every 6 shots

keys: 每个弹匣的最后一发必定暴击，命中后分裂成两发
en: The last round of every magazine always crits and splits in two on hit

keys: 8 秒狂热：射速 ×4、不用换弹、子弹穿透、移速 +30%、击杀回血
en: 8-second frenzy: fire rate ×4, no reloading, piercing shots, +30% move speed, heal on kill

keys: 巡演舞台 · 第一声枪响
en: The Touring Stage · The First Shot

keys:
女士们，先生们——
表演开始了。
en:
Ladies and gentlemen—
the show begins.

keys: 射程极短、出手极快的近身连刺
en: Lightning-fast stabs at extremely short range

keys: 身边每有 1 个敌人，伤害 +6%（最多 +60%）
en: +6% damage for each nearby enemy (up to +60%)

keys: 无敌并连续瞬移到 15 个敌人身后各斩一刀，最后五百骑幻影横扫全屏
en: Invincible while blinking behind 15 enemies to strike each one, then five hundred phantom riders sweep the screen

keys: 累计完成 3 个支线剧情
孤城之下 · 摘下鬼面

en: Five hundred riders — into the fray with me.

keys: 以自身为中心扩散的魔法环，伤害并击退敌人
en: A ring of magic expands outward, damaging and knocking back enemies

keys: 每次升级多一个选项（四选一）
en: One extra choice on every level-up (choose 1 of 4)

keys: 一圈巨石从天而降砸在身边，之后 8 秒内敌人无法进入石阵
en: A ring of megaliths crashes down around you; enemies can't enter the circle for 8 seconds

keys: 花费 3 点支线剧情点

群山也会听从言语，
只要你知道它们的名字。
en:
Even mountains heed a word,
if you know their names.

keys: 死后不得安息的古代战士。芬布尔之冬的第三年，墓丘的冻土裂开，他们拖着锈蚀的兵器爬了出来。
en: Ancient warriors who found no rest in death. In the third year of Fimbulwinter, the frozen barrows cracked open and they crawled out, dragging their rusted weapons.

keys: 追随斯库尔与哈提的狼群。巨狼在天上追逐日月，它们就在人间的雪原上狩猎。
en: The wolf packs that follow Sköll and Hati. While the great wolves chase the sun and moon across the sky, they hunt the snowfields of the mortal world.

keys: 速度快、血量少，成群出现。
en: Fast and frail, they come in packs.

keys: 冻死在风雪里的人留下的怨念，凝成了冰。它们从不靠近，只远远地投出冰锥。
en: The grudges of those who froze to death in the blizzard, condensed into ice. They never come close — they hurl icicles from afar.

keys: 赫列姆大军的先锋。霜巨人从冰封的海上走来，每一步都让地面震动。
en: The vanguard of Hrym's army. The frost giants walk across the frozen sea, and the ground shakes with every step.

keys: 体型大、移动慢，一击很重。
en: Huge and slow, but every blow hits hard.

keys: 病死、老死的普通人，没有资格进入英灵殿。他们排着长队走进冥界，如今被海拉征召入伍。
en: Ordinary folk who died of sickness or old age, unworthy of Valhalla. They filed into Helheim in long lines, and now Hel has conscripted them.

keys: 很弱，但一来就是一大群。
en: Very weak, but they come in huge crowds.

keys: 被困在冥雾里的灵魂。它们早已感受不到温度，只能从活人身上汲取。
en: Souls trapped in the mist of the dead. They have long since lost all warmth and can only drain it from the living.

keys: 能穿过其他敌人，远程吸取你的生命。
en: Passes through other enemies and drains your life from range.

keys: 住在地底的精灵，与冥界结盟。苍白的皮肤从未见过阳光。
en: Elves who dwell beneath the earth, allied with the underworld. Their pale skin has never seen the sun.

keys: 远程射箭，被攻击时有几率闪开。
en: Ranged archer that may dodge your attacks.

keys: 用建造纳吉尔法尔剩下的指甲拼成的人形。打碎它，碎片还会自己爬起来。
en: A figure assembled from nails left over from building Naglfar. Shatter it, and the pieces crawl back up on their own.

keys: 死亡时分裂成 3 个小傀儡。
en: Splits into 3 small golems when it dies.

keys: 指甲傀儡碎裂后的残片，仍然记得要攻击活人。
en: Fragments of a shattered nail golem that still remember to attack the living.

keys: 巨狼斯库尔追逐太阳女神苏尔的马车已有千年。芬布尔之冬的第三年，它终于追上了。
en: For a thousand years the great wolf Sköll has chased the chariot of the sun goddess Sól. In the third year of Fimbulwinter, it finally caught her.

keys: 扑咬冲锋 · 吞日：视野越来越暗 · 血量过半后召唤狼群
en: Lunging charge · Devour the Sun: your vision darkens · Summons wolves below half health

keys: 斯库尔的兄弟，日夜追逐月神玛尼。月光越暗，它越强大。
en: Sköll's brother, who chases the moon god Máni day and night. The darker the moonlight, the stronger he grows.

keys: 月影分身：只有脚下有影子的是本体 · 月蚀嚎叫让人恐惧 · 斯库尔死后陷入狂暴
en: Moon shadows: only the one with a shadow at its feet is real · Eclipse howl causes fear · Goes berserk if Sköll is dead

keys: 霜巨人的领袖，从东方横渡冰封的海洋而来。预言说，他将驾驶亡者之船纳吉尔法尔。
en: Leader of the frost giants, who crossed the frozen ocean from the east. Prophecy says he will steer Naglfar, the ship of the dead.

keys: 冰霜践踏 · 冰柱牢笼 · 冰川巨盾：只能从背后攻击 · 半血后召唤霜巨人
en: Frost stomp · Ice pillar prison · Glacier shield: attack from behind · Summons frost giants below half health

keys: 被锁在冥界入口洞窟里的恶犬，胸前永远沾满鲜血。预言说它的吠叫会宣告诸神黄昏，最终它将与战神提尔同归于尽。
en: The hound chained in the cave at Helheim's gate, its chest forever soaked in blood. Prophecy says its baying will herald Ragnarök, and that it will die together with Tyr, the god of war.

keys: 三段扑咬 · 地狱吠叫驱散增益 · 打断 4 根锁桩后挣脱
en: Triple lunge · Hellish howl dispels buffs · Breaks free once all 4 stakes are broken

keys: 世界树最深的根下，黑龙尼德霍格日夜啃咬树根，吞食罪人的尸体。世界树的颤抖，就是它造成的。
en: Beneath the deepest root of Yggdrasil, the black dragon Nidhogg gnaws at the roots day and night and devours the corpses of the wicked. The World Tree trembles because of it.

keys: 潜地突袭 · 毒息留下毒池 · 啃树根回血，打够伤害能打断
en: Burrowing ambush · Poison breath leaves toxic pools · Gnaws the root to heal — deal enough damage to interrupt

keys: 洛基的女儿，身体一半是美丽的女人，一半是腐烂的尸骸。奥丁把她丢进冥界，她便成了这里的女王。如今她要带着亡者向诸神复仇。
en: Loki's daughter, half beautiful woman and half rotting corpse. Odin cast her into the underworld, and she became its queen. Now she leads the dead to take revenge on the gods.

keys: 生死二相 · 亡者大军 · 死亡领域 · 登上纳吉尔法尔，降下指甲弹幕
en: Life and Death · Army of the dead · Domain of death · Boards Naglfar and rains down nails

keys: 村庄里还有幸存者，围在最后一堆篝火旁。亡者一波接一波地围上来。
en: Survivors still huddle around the village's last bonfire. The dead close in, wave after wave.

keys: 奥丁的两只渡鸦福金（思想）与雾尼（记忆）每天飞遍九界，这一次却在风雪中迷了路。
en: Odin's ravens Huginn (Thought) and Muninn (Memory) fly across the Nine Realms every day — but this time they are lost in the blizzard.

keys: 女武神在空中挑选值得进入英灵殿的战士。证明你的武勇。
en: The Valkyries choose from the sky the warriors worthy of Valhalla. Prove your valor.

keys: 亡者之船纳吉尔法尔是用死人的指甲造的。每收走一片指甲，它就晚一点完工。
en: Naglfar, the ship of the dead, is built from the nails of the dead. Every nail taken delays it a little more.

keys: 冰湖下冻着霜巨人的战士。冰正在融化，必须在他们醒来之前打碎冰块。
en: Frost giant warriors lie frozen beneath the lake. The ice is melting — break it before they wake.

keys: 霜巨人的祭司在码头召唤寒潮，为大军的到来铺路。
en: The frost giants' priests summon a cold wave at the harbor, paving the way for their army.

keys: 芬布尔之冬最冷的一阵寒潮。离开火盆，体温就会一点点流失。
en: The coldest wave of Fimbulwinter. Step away from the braziers and your body heat drains away.

keys: 命运三女神诺伦在十字路口纺线。每一条线都有它的代价。
en: The Norns spin their threads at the crossroads. Every thread has its price.

keys: 斯库尔追咬太阳时，咬下了一块余烬。把它送到符文石阵，太阳的力量就归你。
en: Sköll bit off an ember while chasing the sun. Bring it to the rune stones and the sun's power is yours.

keys: 托尔曾在冰湖上垂钓，钩上来的是尘世巨蟒。他的鱼竿还插在冰洞旁。
en: Thor once fished on this frozen lake and hooked the World Serpent. His rod still stands by the ice hole.

keys: 十字路口的路标石上刻着三个符文，各自指向一处地标。
en: Three runes are carved into the waystone at the crossroads, each pointing to a landmark.

keys: 一只扛着战利品的霜巨人，正顺着脚印走回冰海。
en: A frost giant carrying its spoils is following its footprints back to the ice sea.

keys: 墓丘之中有一座墓始终没有裂开。里面睡着一位还没去英灵殿报到的战士。
en: One grave in the barrows has never cracked open. Inside sleeps a warrior who has yet to report to Valhalla.

keys: 亡者广场四角的磷火灯柱为新来的亡者引路。灯灭了，他们便在雾里迷失。
en: Phosphor lamps at the four corners of the Plaza of the Dead guide newcomers. When they go dark, the dead are lost in the mist.

keys: 守护吉欧尔桥的少女拦住了你：「活人为什么要过冥界的桥？」
en: The maiden guarding Gjallarbrú blocks your way: "Why would the living cross the bridge of the dead?"

keys: 纳吉尔法尔被锚链拴在港口。锚链断一条，起航就晚一刻。
en: Naglfar is chained to the harbor. Every chain broken delays its voyage a little longer.

keys: 光明之神巴德尔被洛基设计害死，灵魂困在海拉的大厅深处。诸神曾求海拉放他回去。
en: Baldr, god of light, died by Loki's scheme, and his soul is trapped deep in Hel's hall. The gods once begged Hel to let him go.

keys: 松鼠拉塔托斯克在世界树上跑上跑下，在巨鹰与尼德霍格之间传递挑拨的流言。
en: The squirrel Ratatoskr scurries up and down Yggdrasil, carrying spiteful rumors between the eagle and Nidhogg.

keys: 指甲工坊里，亡者把收来的指甲堆成小山，再一片片拼上船身。
en: In the nail workshop, the dead pile collected nails into mounds, then fit them onto the hull one by one.

keys: 曾有人骑着八足神驹来到冥界，求海拉放回巴德尔。蹄印一路通向冥界之外。
en: Someone once rode an eight-legged steed into Helheim to beg Hel for Baldr's return. The hoofprints lead out of the underworld.

keys: 冥河里漂满了刀剑。浅滩的冰下，有一把至今还在发光。
en: The river of the dead is full of drifting blades. Under the ice of the ford, one still glows.
The Giantess Who Would Not Weep

keys: 万物都为巴德尔哭泣，只有一个女巨人不肯。她说：「我只会流干涩的眼泪。」
en: All things wept for Baldr — all but one giantess. She said: "I will weep only dry tears."

加姆 · 尼德霍格 · 海拉

en:
A horn sounds in the distance — Heimdall, watchman of the gods, has blown the Gjallarhorn.
Ragnarök has begun.
The dead crawl out of the barrows!
The frost giant vanguard has arrived!

keys: 暴风雪中浮现出无数精魂！
en: Countless spirits emerge from the blizzard!

keys:
纳吉尔法尔在火光中沉没。但远方的天空已经燃烧起来，彩虹桥正在崩塌。
所有的神与所有的巨人，都在走向同一片平原。
en:
Naglfar sinks in flames. But the distant sky is already burning, and Bifröst is collapsing.
Every god and every giant is marching toward the same plain.
A procession of the dead surges toward you!
Dark elves emerge from the mist!
